subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

THRIVE
solution:
The correct answer is '**Shrink**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Thrive**' is '**Shrink**'.
 
• **Thrive**: to grow or develop well. (सफलतापूर्वक बढ़ना या विकसित होना, फलना-फूलना)
 
 
• *Example: Turkeys **thrive** well, grow to a fine size and have flesh of tender quality.*
 
 
 
• **Shrink**: to become smaller or make something smaller. [(किसी वस्‍तु का) सिकुड़ जाना या किसी वस्‍तु को सिकोड़ देना (आकार में छोटा हो जाना या कर देना)]
 
 
• *Example: My T-shirt **shrank** in the wash.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Shrink.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Prosper**: to develop in a successful way; to be successful, especially with money. (सफलतापूर्वक विकसित होना, फलना-फूलना; धन की दृष्टि से समृद्घ होना)
 
• **Develop**: to grow slowly, increase, or change into something else; to make somebody/something do this. (विकसित होना; विकास करना)
 
• **Shine**: to send out or to send back (reflect) light; to be bright. (चमकाना या चमक बिखेरना)
